title: DSPy Retrieval Modules
summary: This module provides various retrieval mechanisms for fetching relevant information, including local ColBERTv2 implementations, Databricks Vector Search integration, and Weaviate integration. It defines core retrieval classes and utilities for managing retrieved passages within DSPy programs.

nodes.label: Manage Local ColBERTv2 Index
nodes.title: ColBERTv2RetrieverLocal
nodes.description: Builds, loads, and searches a local ColBERTv2 index for passages based on a query.

nodes.label: Rerank Passages Locally
nodes.title: ColBERTv2RerankerLocal
nodes.description: Reranks a given set of passages based on a query using a local ColBERTv2 model.

nodes.label: Query Remote ColBERTv2 Service
nodes.title: ColBERTv2
nodes.description: Provides an interface to query a remote ColBERTv2 retrieval service via HTTP requests.

nodes.label: Retrieve from Databricks Vector Search
nodes.title: DatabricksRM
nodes.description: Connects to and queries a Databricks Mosaic AI Vector Search Index to fetch relevant documents.

nodes.label: Retrieve from Weaviate Database
nodes.title: WeaviateRM
nodes.description: Interacts with a Weaviate collection to retrieve top passages based on a query.

nodes.label: Abstract DSPy Retrieval
nodes.title: Retrieve
nodes.description: A core DSPy module that abstracts retrieval, using a configured Retriever Module (RM) to fetch passages.

nodes.label: Retrieve Embeddings with Scores
nodes.title: EmbeddingsWithScores
nodes.description: Extends base embedding retrieval to also return similarity scores alongside passages and indices.

nodes.label: Wrap ColBERTv2 GET Request
nodes.title: colbertv2_get_request_v2_wrapped
nodes.description: A utility function for making GET requests to a ColBERTv2 service.

nodes.label: Wrap ColBERTv2 POST Request
nodes.title: colbertv2_post_request_v2_wrapped
nodes.description: A utility function for making POST requests to a ColBERTv2 service.

nodes.label: Process Retrieved Passages
nodes.title: single_query_passage
nodes.description: Transforms raw retrieved passages into a structured DSPy Prediction object.

nodes.label: Globally Configured Retriever
nodes.title: dspy.settings.rm
nodes.description: The globally configured retriever module that DSPy programs use for retrieval operations.

nodes.label: ColBERT-AI Library
nodes.title: colbert-ai
nodes.description: The external Python library providing ColBERTv2 functionalities for local indexing, searching, and reranking.

nodes.label: Databricks SDK
nodes.title: databricks-sdk
nodes.description: The official Databricks Python SDK used for programmatic interaction with Databricks services, including Vector Search.

nodes.label: Weaviate Client Library
nodes.title: weaviate-client
nodes.description: The official Weaviate Python client library for connecting to and querying Weaviate vector databases.

nodes.label: HTTP Requests Library
nodes.title: requests-library
nodes.description: A popular Python library for making HTTP requests, used here for direct API calls to Databricks Vector Search.

nodes.label: DSPy Prediction Object
nodes.title: dspy.Prediction
nodes.description: A standard DSPy object used to encapsulate and return the results of a prediction or retrieval operation.
